planets.name: WASP-157 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-157 with a 3.95-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-157 b crosses its star every 3.95 days and is as wide as Jupiter, found in 2016.
text.introduction: WASP-157 b transits WASP-157 every 3.95 days and is as wide as Jupiter. Orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): pl_orbper 3.951623, pl_radj 0.99830493, pl_bmassj 0.574
